resource_policy: fresh own-process CPU/RAM/filesystem observation; use available resources; no shared changes; no transient host PSI kill; only actual inputs/SOURCE/runtime/grant/results are immutable
failure_policy: STOP on own process failure, invalid input/source/profile/control/phase, nonfinite values, unpaired cost events or scientific mismatch; missing candidate cost remains null, no refit/imputation
seed_namespace: HIGHER_PF_INDEPENDENT_V1 + campaign + stage + formula/system/q + replica + outer + piece + input hash
legacy_seed_exclusion: before sampling reconstruct all legacy seeds from H4 seed SOURCE/group/sample/outer/piece and compare actual uint64 values; check entire fresh exploration and confirmation registry for collisions; disjoint tag strings alone are insufficient
CRN: disabled; cross-candidate independence is an explicit statistical assumption, not proved by unique seeds. A CRN design needs separate coupling/provenance approval.
cost_pairing: same event digest and seed for cosine/sine; independent trajectory is sampling unit
estimation: exact integer cost mean/sample variance; paired weighted SE; independent-candidate difference SE and delta-method ratio SE are exploratory, no strict interval
rare_events: do not zero-impute unobserved multi2/s4; forced samples are correctness controls only. Population conclusion deferred unless full-support variance/tail assumptions or certified bounds are independently supplied.
sample_size: user supplies target MCSE or detectable effect/power/multiplicity; pilot variance plug-in planning only; no automatic adoption or extension
budget_formula: 2*k*n_confirmation compiled sample axes for k pre-fixed candidates, plus separately registered correctness/control compiles; if one winner/formula/system then k=6 is an option only
storage: private event replay and sample/phase registry, public summary and comparison diagnostics; estimate from chosen k,n before sealing
